description: Fix critical and high-severity bugs: type errors, missing types, singleton disconnect, infinite loop, stale headers, collision-prone IDs, and process.env usage
steps: Bug #1 - src/shared/api/names/api.ts: The addName function uses withSupabase(operation, null) which means if Supabase is unavailable it returns null, but the return type is Promise<NameItem>. Fix by throwing an error in the null fallback case. Change the implementation to: after withSupabase returns, check if result is null and throw, OR better: restructure to throw inside withSupabase's operation on error cases. The simplest fix: change `}, null)` to throw if result is null: wrap the withSupabase call and throw if null is returned.

Bug #2 - src/features/tournament/hooks/useTournamentRealtime.ts: MessageHandler type is used on line `private messageHandlers = new Map<string, Set<MessageHandler>>()` but never defined. Add a type definition: `type MessageHandler = (payload: unknown) => void;` before the class.

Bug #3 - src/features/tournament/hooks/useTournamentRealtime.ts: sendMessage() references `this.appChannel` which doesn't exist. The class has dbChannel and tournamentChannels but no appChannel. Fix: either add a private appChannel property and initialize it, or change sendMessage to use dbChannel (the db-changes channel). Since there's no app channel setup anywhere, the simplest fix is to declare `private appChannel: RealtimeChannel | null = null;` and document it needs setup, OR better: make sendMessage use the dbChannel for broadcasting since that's the only general channel.

Bug #4 - src/features/tournament/hooks/useTournamentRealtime.ts: The singleton service is disconnected in the useEffect cleanup of useTournamentRealtime hook. If multiple components use the hook, one unmounting kills it for all. Fix: add a reference counter. Add a private `refCount = 0` property. In connect, increment refCount. Add a `release()` method that decrements refCount and only calls disconnect() when it reaches 0. Update the hook's cleanup to call release() instead of disconnect().

Bug #5 - src/features/dashboard/components/analytics/RankingAdjustment.tsx: The auto-save useEffect (second useEffect with deps [items, rankings, onSave]) fires whenever items differ from rankings. After save completes, it sets hasUnsavedChanges to false, but items and rankings still differ (items were reordered by user). This causes the effect to re-fire. Fix: the auto-save effect should only fire when hasUnsavedChanges is true. Add `if (!hasUnsavedChanges) return;` at the start of that effect body.

Bug #6 - src/shared/services/supabase/runtime.ts: Headers (x-user-name, x-user-id) are baked in at Supabase client creation time. The updateSupabaseUserContext function tries to patch them via internal client properties which is fragile. Fix: Use the Supabase client's built-in `setAuth` or global fetch interceptor approach. The simplest fix: use supabaseInstance.rest.headers properly. Actually, review the existing updateSupabaseUserContext - it already patches headers. The real issue is the headers are set at creation time and never updated when user logs in/out. The function exists but may not be called. Verify it's called from auth flows. If it IS called, the bug is that the internal patching path `internalClient.rest?.headers` may not work with newer Supabase client versions. Fix: replace with Supabase's official approach - use `client.functions.setAuth()` or re-create the client, OR use a global headers object reference that gets mutated. Simplest fix: change the createClient options to use a getter function for headers by wrapping in a custom fetch that reads current values from storage.

Bug #7 - src/features/tournament/hooks/tournamentPersistence.ts: createTournamentId uses raw name strings joined with '-' which can collide (e.g., 'A-B' + 'C' vs 'A' + 'B-C'). Fix: Use a hash of sorted IDs (numeric/string IDs, not display names). Change to use the same createSortedKey function used for namesKey, and hash it. Use a simple string hash function to create a short deterministic ID.

Bug #8 - src/shared/services/errorManager.ts: Uses `process.env.NODE_ENV` on line in the logError function which is not available in Vite browser builds. Fix: replace with `import.meta.env.DEV` check. Also fix the same issue in runtime.ts where `const isDev = typeof process !== 'undefined' && process.env?.NODE_ENV === 'development'` - replace with `import.meta.env?.DEV ?? false`.
acceptance_criteria: TypeScript type checking passes: bun run tsc --project config/tsconfig.json --noEmit
Biome linting has no new errors: bun run biome check --config-path config/biome.json src
addName properly throws when Supabase is unavailable instead of returning null
MessageHandler type is defined and used consistently
sendMessage uses a declared channel property
Realtime service uses reference counting for disconnect
RankingAdjustment auto-save only triggers when hasUnsavedChanges is true
Supabase headers are dynamically resolved via custom fetch wrapper
Tournament IDs use hashed sorted IDs instead of raw name strings
No process.env.NODE_ENV references remain in browser-facing code
verification: bun run biome check --config-path config/biome.json src
